summary: Eleven-metre loading-zone and taxi-zone kerb on Moggill Road, too short for a van.
reasons: Only 11 m, under a van length

drivers.seclusion: Shopfronts at the start and a car park behind trees; in full view of the high street.
drivers.access_and_room: Stretch is 11 m and sits beside a bus stop and taxi zone; no room to fit a van clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Loading zone, no stopping 4-7pm weekdays and taxi zone at other times; not a place to sleep.

flags: Loading zone, no stopping and taxi zone signed
sun_shade: Street tree shades the east end; open to the south sun.
